verdict.rationale: Nitrokey's own materials document FIDO2 and U2F support. They name Google for U2F website login, and Microsoft services (Office 365, Entra ID) for passwordless FIDO login, so the core second-factor story is clearly delivered. Missing for 10: any evidence naming GitHub or password managers as working services, and independent or hands-on corroboration of cross-service WebAuthn compatibility.
